purpose: Teach: 経ち/冷房/断然/少量/丸く/傾い/羽目/延ばし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 梅雨も明けて、夏休みが、経ち始めたね。
lines.en: The rainy season's finally over—and now summer break's actually starting.
lines.style: Light, conversational opening. Natural cadence, slightly animated on 'finally.' Noticing something worth noting but not making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。教室の冷房、強すぎて寒い。
lines.en: Yeah. The AC in the classroom is way too strong—it's freezing in there.
lines.style: Dry, understated complaint. Flat delivery on the initial 'Yeah,' slight wry edge on 'way too strong.' Not really bothered, just stating fact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 断然、この味のジュース、好き。
lines.en: Honestly, I'm really into this juice flavor.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm, a little lighter than before. Direct statement, no irony. Brief bright energy when she means what she says.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昼の弁当、おかず、少量で済ませた。
lines.en: I just had a small lunch—figured small sides would do the trick.
lines.style: Conversational, matter-of-fact. Shrugging in the voice. Not self-conscious, just describing the practical choice he made.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスのみんなと、輪になって、丸く座る。
lines.en: Everyone in the class sat down in a circle together.
lines.style: Warm, observant. Slight softness when describing the togetherness. Noticing something gentle about the moment without overselling it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 机、誰か蹴って、傾いた状態だった。
lines.en: Someone kicked a desk and left it all tilted.
lines.style: Dry, slightly amused. Understatement in the delivery. Wry observation of small chaos, delivered flat and unruffled.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、サボる羽目になっちゃう。
lines.en: I ended up having to skip club activities.
lines.style: Quieter shift. Matter-of-fact but with underlying acceptance. No complaint, just the simple fact of what happened. Slight resignation underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試合、来週まで延ばしになった。
lines.en: The match got pushed back to next week.
lines.style: Reflective, factual close. Steady, measured tone. No disappointment on the surface, just noting the change. Slight pause before or after, letting it settle.
